title: Reproduce a workspace in a clean browser
description: Verify that current export imported into a clean browser reproduces all implemented records, assets, relationships, normalized scenes, preparation audits, and known deterministic PDF hashes.
acceptanceCriteria: A clean context import reproduces projects, layouts, templates/data/assignments, snapshots, assets, setups, profiles, sheet instances, and preparations implemented by this release
All internal references resolve and normalized scene inputs are deeply equivalent after round trip
Regenerated PDFs for canonical preparations retain their known deterministic hashes
Binary asset bytes and integrity hashes are identical
Any later registered durable type, including calibration drafts when implemented, participates automatically or fails completeness checks

steps.details: Build a bounded workspace fixture containing at least one of every registered durable type, relationships, named snapshot, binary asset, instance omission, and preparation mode.
Export offline, open an isolated empty browser context/database, and verify no preexisting application records or caches affect the import.
Review/confirm the plan, commit, then compare canonical records, references, scene inputs, assets, compatibility/reuse audits, and counts.
Regenerate canonical prepared outputs and assert known PDF hashes plus used-position omissions match the source workspace.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; use one bounded canonical workspace fixture and focused hash comparisons.
Compare normalized logical state where IndexedDB-internal ordering is irrelevant and exact bytes where assets/PDFs require it.
Do not fabricate calibration drafts before their later PRD is implemented.
